title: MRL WorkerResult (untrusted)
description: The ONLY object Claude returns in the Minimum Reliable Loop. It is UNTRUSTED and carries the worker's self-reported outcome plus two human-readable text fields, and nothing else. It has no run/task/session ids, no SHAs, no branch/origin, no model or executable identity, no gate/test results and no evidence digests; the controller constructs every such factual field from its own observed run/task/session/Git facts (D-024-R501/R503). additionalProperties is false, so any forged factual field is rejected fail-closed. The worker's outcome is a CLAIM, never itself an advancement decision.
